title: What Most People Get Wrong About Hair Extensions
meta_title: What Most People Get Wrong About Hair Extensions
meta_description: Learn the most common hair extension mistakes and how to care for them properly. Expert tips from Studio One Hair Design.
author: Studio One Hair Design
body_text:
Think your hair extensions are invincible? Not quite. One of the most common things we hear in the salon is, “I wish someone had told me this sooner.” Extensions can be absolutely life-changing, but only when they’re cared for correctly. The biggest mistake most people make isn’t choosing the wrong hair — it’s misunderstanding how to treat it once it’s installed.

If you’re wearing extensions (or considering them), chances are you made at least one of these mistakes early on. And honestly? You’re not alone. Let’s break down what most people get wrong about hair extensions — and how to fix it.

Brushing Too Hard Without Holding the Base

This is hands down one of the biggest extension mistakes we see.

When brushing your hair, it’s essential to support the base of your extensions. Brushing aggressively from the root without holding the hair creates tension on both the extension row and your natural hair. Over time, that tension can lead to unnecessary shedding, matting, and even discomfort at the scalp.

The right way to brush extensions:

Always hold the hair at the base with one hand

Start brushing from the ends and work your way up

Use a brush designed for extensions

Be extra gentle when the hair is damp

Proper brushing protects your investment and keeps your extensions looking seamless and natural. If you’re unsure what tools to use, your stylist should always guide you during your visit at Studio One Hair Design.

Skipping Weekly Deep Conditioning

Extensions don’t receive natural oils from your scalp the way your own hair does. That means moisture is everything.

Skipping weekly deep conditioning is a fast track to dry, brittle extensions that tangle easily and lose their shine. Hydrated hair equals smooth hair — and smooth hair lasts longer.

Why weekly deep conditioning matters:

Restores moisture lost from styling and heat

Reduces friction and tangling

Keeps extensions soft, shiny, and manageable

Extends the overall lifespan of your hair

At Studio One, we always recommend professional-grade products and treatments tailored to extension wearers. You can explore curated products designed for extension care through our Studio One Shop.

Not Using a Silk Pillowcase

What happens while you sleep matters more than most people realize.

Cotton pillowcases create friction. That friction leads to tangling, matting, and dryness — especially around the nape and crown. A silk pillowcase allows your hair to glide while you sleep, reducing stress on both your extensions and natural hair.

Benefits of switching to silk:

Less friction and breakage

Reduced tangling and matting

Better moisture retention

Smoother hair in the morning

Think of a silk pillowcase as part of your extension maintenance routine — just like brushing and conditioning.

Extensions Are Luxury Hair — Not Low Maintenance

One of the biggest misconceptions is expecting extensions to be “set it and forget it.” While they should feel effortless, they still require intentional care. When treated correctly, extensions save time, boost confidence, and deliver consistent, beautiful hair days.

If you’re new to extensions or considering them, working with a knowledgeable stylist makes all the difference. Our team is trained to educate guests, customize installs, and support long-term hair health. Learn more about our approach on the Services page or explore our extension offerings like beaded row extensions.

You can also meet the expert artists who make the Studio One experience unique on our Meet the Team page.

Ready to Care for Your Extensions the Right Way?

Whether you’re new to extensions or ready to upgrade your experience, proper education and professional guidance matter. When extensions are installed and maintained correctly, they should feel natural, look seamless, and fit effortlessly into your lifestyle.
